description: Learn ground friction through the motion of a freely translating ANCF tire. Gray reference, white simulated tire, identical spin/brake commands, then independent validation.

arg_help.reference-mu: Synthetic ground friction used only to generate observations, 0.15–1.0.
arg_help.initial-mu: Starting friction estimate, 0.15–1.0; pressure, stiffness and carried mass remain fixed.
arg_help.train: Fit friction with implicit trajectory derivatives, then validate a different spin/brake sequence. False shows the initial mismatch until Learn friction is pressed.
arg_help.report: Optional .json report with synthetic provenance, commands, accepted losses and independent validation errors. This is not a calibrated example 07 preset.
